stories.title: GitLab Patches Critical 9.9 AI Gateway Flaw Allowing Command Execution on Self-Hosted Servers
stories.description: GitLab fixed CVE-2026-90970, a 9.9 AI Gateway flaw that could let logged-in Duo Agent Platform users run commands on self-hosted gateways.

stories.title: Antino Backdoor Uses Outlook and OneDrive for C2 in China-Nexus Espionage Campaign
stories.description: China-nexus UAT-11587 targets Asian government and policy groups with Antino, a Rust backdoor that uses Microsoft 365 for C2.

stories.title: Dell CSM Flaws Enable Unauthenticated Admin Access and Root on Kubernetes Nodes
stories.description: Dell fixes six CSM flaws enabling authentication bypass, storage credential access, and cluster-wide privilege escalation.

stories.title: Hackers Turned a Microsoft SQL Server Into a Command and Data Exfiltration Channel
stories.description: Hackers abused a Microsoft SQL Server to run commands, steal credentials and source code, and move files in a Viva Aerobus-linked attack.

stories.title: Hackers Poison Trusted Software Updates to Steal Developer and Cloud Credentials
stories.description: Hackers exploit trusted software updates to steal developer and cloud credentials through poisoned packages and compromised release pipelines.

stories.title: Critical Red Hat Satellite Flaw Could Enable Root Password Theft and Code Execution Attacks
stories.description: Red Hat fixed a Satellite flaw exposing sensitive host data and potentially enabling command execution as the Foreman service account.

stories.title: Multiple Cpanel/WHM Vulnerabilities Allow Arbitrary Command Execution On Server
